subject: A single architectural grid-frame model, wide and low: a lattice skeleton of thin pale timber members forming 5 columns by 3 rows of square cells (like the frame of a hanok courtyard house or a display shelf grid), standing alone on a long low dark plinth in a museum. Exactly one cell, lower left, holds a muted red panel.
purpose: Photo set inside the square counter of a huge Korean letter on a black magazine page; the whole object must fill a wide frame edge to edge.
style: Editorial museum photography, real photograph, sharp, medium-format look, no illustration. Same material and joinery as a refined timber model.
composition: Frontal, orthographic-looking, the whole model fills about 90% of the frame width, small even black margin all around, plinth just visible at the bottom.
palette: Near-black background, warm pale wood, one muted red cell.
lighting: Single soft museum spotlight from above, deep shadows, no glare.
notes: Background must fall to pure black so it sits on a (4,5,5) black page.
